# Test-MftPhysicalSeedContracts.ps1

Runs non-privileged static and mocked contract cases for physical MFT seed identity/provenance and safe evidence creation. Coverage includes VM/C:/unattached/fixed VHDX/protected-role/identity/size rejection; volume-root, repository, OneDrive/Documents, non-fixed/non-NTFS, low-space, nonempty, reparse, and stale-volume plan rejection; atomic run-directory and VHDX create-seam collisions; Windows command-line quoting for whitespace, embedded quotes, and trailing backslashes; pre-mutation .NET executable resolution; external monitor validity, trace completeness/lost events, write-only operations, capture interval, hash/target/legacy final-gate failures; and benchmark artifact provenance fields plus refusal to create arbitrary parents or overwrite existing evidence. The test also statically verifies runner propagation of validated evidence paths/hashes and process identities.

It does not query host disks, create directories for collision tests, create/attach/format VHDX, start a product or benchmark, or claim physical acceptance. `build/quality/Test-Quality.ps1` includes this contract suite.
